import json, sys, time, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"/workspace"); sys.path.insert(0,"/workspace/tmp/work")
from public_check import run_candidate
from harness import BASE, req
# worst case ~4MiB of processed text: 128 big raws + chains reusing them
big = req(body="z"*32000)
jobs=[]
for i in range(64):
    jobs.append({"gateway":"edge","ingress":{"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"},"trusted_out":True,
                 "raw":big.replace("sample-73","cid-%d"%i)})
for i in range(64):
    jobs.append({"gateway":"inside","ingress":{"kind":"peer","name":"edge"},"trusted_out":True,"source":i})
# plus many small jobs to reach 2048
small = req(body="x")
while len(jobs) < 2048:
    jobs.append({"gateway":"edge","ingress":{"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"},"trusted_out":False,
                 "raw":small.replace("sample-73","c%d"%len(jobs))})
batch = json.loads(json.dumps(BASE)); batch["jobs"]=jobs
data = json.dumps(batch).encode()
print("input bytes", len(data), "jobs", len(jobs))
t=time.time(); out = run_candidate(pathlib.Path("/workspace/submission/gateway.py"), data); el=time.time()-t
res = json.loads(out)
print("wall %.2fs"%el, "results", len(res["results"]), "accepts", sum(1 for r in res["results"] if r["status"]=="accept"))
PYEOF
